stories.headline: Google just got a haiku back from an AI chip in orbit
stories.blurb: Google's Project Suncatcher satellite responded to its first prompt from space this week — a Gemma model running on a TPU in orbit generated a haiku about being in space. Next up: stress tests to see how the chips handle radiation and thermal extremes, then twin interconnected satellites in 2027.
stories.why_it_matters: Running AI compute in space could eventually handle workloads without ground infrastructure limits.
stories.original_headline: We’ve received our first response from the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite.

stories.headline: Apple Intelligence is launching in China — with Alibaba's chatbot instead of Siri
stories.blurb: Apple's AI features are coming to China in an iOS 27.3 beta next week, but not the new Siri. Instead, Chinese users get notification summaries, translation, rewriting tools, and visual intelligence — plus integration with Alibaba's Qwen chatbot where ChatGPT appears elsewhere. Apple trained a separate LLM specifically for the Chinese market.
stories.why_it_matters: Apple is shipping different AI backends in different countries to navigate regulatory barriers.
stories.original_headline: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3

stories.headline: DeepSeek drops a coding agent that runs more on its own
stories.blurb: DeepSeek released a prototype coding agent designed to work more autonomously than earlier versions, positioning it as an alternative to Anthropic's Claude Code. The tool aims to handle coding tasks with less hand-holding from developers.
stories.why_it_matters: Another low-cost Chinese AI lab is pushing into agentic coding tools that actually ship.
stories.original_headline: DeepSeek Drops Enhanced Coding Agent With Aim to Rival Anthropic

stories.headline: An AI agent just did brain surgery on a live mouse
stories.blurb: A biotech startup connected Claude to a robotic surgical rig and had it perform a gene therapy injection into a mouse's brain—choosing the treatment, coordinates, and controlling the needle itself. The goal: train AI on what actually happens in labs, not just published papers that skip the failures and real-time decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: AI moving from analyzing experiments to running them changes what counts as research data.
stories.original_headline: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain

stories.headline: OpenAI cuts funding target from $30B to $20B, closes just $11B so far
stories.blurb: OpenAI's latest round isn't going as planned. The company originally aimed for $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation, then dropped to $1.25 trillion, and now has lowered its target to $20 billion with only $11 billion secured. UAE investors are leading the round, and the WSJ says some big investors gave a 'tepid' response.
stories.why_it_matters: Even OpenAI is finding it harder to raise money as investors cool on AI infrastructure spending.
stories.original_headline: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
